== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[Red 2]]. One column per published text state, in date order: the printed card, and each Players Committee image. The stamp row describes the mark on each image. Yellow highlights mark words changed against the column before. Use explicit <code>1=</code> for <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> arguments.

Icons row: the printed cards have no [[Nav Computer]] icon (Limited faces ANH-L-red2-hires.webp and ANH-L-red2-decipher-archive.gif; Revised face ANH-R-L-red2wb.gif; Japanese face Japanese-ANH-Red-2-SWCA-67645.jpg). The 2017 slip adds it, a red square with an astromech dome at the right of the game-text box, and the 2018 E card keeps it.
